instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. United, Delta, American, Alaska bear fuel risk for contracted flights. SKYW bears fuel risk on pro-rate operations (~12-14% of revenue). Avg price $2.01/gal in 2017. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons purchased: ~80,767 thousand gallons (fiscal year ended December 31, 2017) from Item 7 table. Note: SkyWest prorate gallons only.
